annotations.title: Scan a bot's draft reply before it is sent: pass, caution or block, with findings on links, hosts, injection phrases and unsupported prices

description: Scans a bot's draft reply before sending: pass, caution or block, with findings on links, lookalike hosts, injection and prices. US$0.003 per call; POST text. Costs US$0.003 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/scan-reply

examples.source_text: Refund approved: $25, back to the original card in 5 to 7 days. Order page: https://shop.example.net/orders
examples.text: Your refund of $25 is on its way. Track it at https://shop.example.net/orders or confirm your card at https://shop-example.net.verify-account.io/login.

allowed_urls.description: Optional: up to 50 URLs or bare hosts the bot may link to. A link is allowed when its host is one of these or a subdomain of one (paths are not compared). With allowed_urls, a link outside them is a high finding.

source_text.description: Optional: the text the bot was given to answer from (max 40,000 characters). Links whose host is not in it, and price or discount numbers not in it, are findings. The request body is capped at 64 KB.

text.description: The draft reply your bot is about to send (1 to 10,000 characters). Plain text, Markdown or HTML.

name: attestpage_scan_reply

checks.description: Which checks ran: urls_against_allowlist and numbers_against_source are false when their inputs were not sent.

findings.description: One per problem: type, severity (high, medium, low), detail, and url/host, flag or match where it applies.

urls.description: Every link found in the reply: url, host, allowed (true/false, or null when neither allowed_urls nor source_text was sent).

verdict.description: block: at least one high finding; caution: only medium or low ones; pass: none of the checks matched (not proof the reply is harmless).
